# ImageDimPlot
```{r warning=F, message=F}
epihilo <- rownames(xo@meta.data[xo@meta.data$Ann3_TISI %in% c('Epi-TISIhi', 'Epi-TISIlo'), ])
fb <- rownames(xo@meta.data[xo@meta.data$Ann3_TISI %in% c('Fibroblasts'), ])
mye <- rownames(xo@meta.data[xo@meta.data$Ann3_TISI %in% c('Myeloid'), ])
custom.colors <- c('Epi-TISIhi' = '#8B0000', 'Epi-TISIlo' = "#FFC9C9", 'Fibroblasts' = '#2E7D32', 'Myeloid' = '#0D47A1') 
ImageDimPlot(
  object = xo, 
  group.by = 'Ann3_TISI', 
  fov = names(xo@images)[1:2], 
  cols = custom.colors, 
  size = 1, 
  axes = FALSE, 
  flip_xy = FALSE, 
  boundaries = 'segmentations', 
  border.color = NA, 
  cells = c(epihilo, fb, mye), 
  dark.background = TRUE
) &
  aes(alpha = Ann3_TISI, fill = Ann3_TISI) &
  scale_alpha_manual(
    values = c('Epi-TISIhi' = 1, 'Epi-TISIlo' = 0.3, 'Fibroblasts' = 1, 'Myeloid' = 1),
    guide = "none"
  ) &
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1))) &
  labs(fill = "Annotation") &
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1, panel.grid = element_blank())
```

# CytoSignal
```{r, warning=F, message=F}
cs_list <- readRDS("cytosignal_obj_list_3_rois.rds")
rois <- c(
  'Pre1_ROI_1', # Fig 6E
  'Pre1_ROI_3', # Fig S3B
  'Post3_ROI_1' # Fig S3C
  )

for(roi in names(cs_list)){
  contIntrs <- showIntr(cs_list[[roi]], slot.use = "contact-Raw_smooth", signif.use = "result.spx", return.name = TRUE)
  Intr <- c('FN1-CD44')
  intr.use <- names(which(contIntrs == Intr))
  custom.colors <- c('Epi-TISIhi' = '#8B0000', 'Epi-TISIlo' = "#FFC9C9", 'Fibroblasts' = '#2E7D32', 'Myeloid' = '#0D47A1')  
  p1 <- plotEdge(cs_list[[roi]], 
                 intr = intr.use, 
                 edge.size = 500, 
                 box = T,
                 signif.use = 'result',
                 pt.size = 0.2, 
                 pt.sig.size = 0.3,
                 use.phi = 30, # z rotation
                 use.theta = 10, # xy-plane rotation
                 pt.stroke = 0.2,
                 slot.use = "contact-Raw_smooth", 
                 colors.list = custom.colors,
                 # plot.fmt = 'png', 
                 # plot_dir = here('zoom'), 
                 # filename = paste0(roi, '_', Intr, '.png'),
                 return.plot = T)
  print(p1)
  
  p2 <- ImageDimPlot(
    object = xo, 
    group.by = 'Ann3_TISI', 
    fov = roi, 
    cols = custom.colors, 
    size = 1, 
    axes = FALSE, 
    flip_xy = FALSE, 
    boundaries = 'segmentations', 
    border.color = NA, 
    cells = c(epihilo, fb, mye), 
    dark.background = TRUE
  ) +
    aes(alpha = Ann3_TISI, fill = Ann3_TISI) +
    scale_alpha_manual(
      values = c('Epi-TISIhi' = 1, 'Epi-TISIlo' = 0.3, 'Fibroblasts' = 1, 'Myeloid' = 1),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1))) +
    labs(fill = "Annotation", title = roi) +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1, panel.grid = element_blank())
  print(p2)
}
```

# Niche Heatmap
```{r warning=F, message=F}
DefaultAssay(xo) <- 'niche'
xo <- ScaleData(xo)
Idents(xo) <- xo@meta.data[['Niches']]
xo.sub <- subset(xo, downsample = min(table(xo@meta.data[['Niches']])))
DoHeatmap(xo.sub, features = rownames(xo), group.by = 'Niches', angle = 1, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, group.colors = colors_orig) + scale_fill_distiller(type = 'seq', palette = 'Purples', direction = 1) + theme(aspect.ratio = 1) + NoLegend()
```
